newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hwa Shin sets rights, bonus issue offer.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Shin sets rights, bonus issue offer.

text.p: South Korea's Hwa Shin Manufacturing Co Ltd plans to offer an 11-for-100 rights issue in May and a six-for-100 bonus issue in June, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The automobile parts maker's paid-in capital would rise to 14 billion won from the current 11.67 billion after the issues, the statement said.
Hwa Shin will issue new 315,256 common shares and allocate 20 percent of the amount to its employees.
The rest will be offered to its shareholders registered as of April 19.
The rights offering will be made at a 20 percent discount on the base issue price, which will be announced later.
Shareholders' subscription for the rights issue is due for May 22 and 23, with payment slated by June 4.
Hwa Shin will issue another new 150,000 common shares for the bonus and distribute them to its shareholders registered as of June 5.
Hwa Shin shares closed Wednesday's trading at 25,500 won, down 1,100 won from the previous close.
